title: Boston Marathon Results hub (BAA)
claims: The BAA results hub links the 2026 Live Tracking & Results entry and the 2026 Results Book, and holds archived results from 1897 through 2000.
On the results hub's 2025 men's open listing, John Korir of Kenya is shown first with a finish net time of 2:04:45.
The hub provides year and group filters (Runners, Wheelchairs, Handcycles, Duos) but the runner table is JS-rendered; at read time only the default year table was legible.
